ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 40% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels concentrated on distal lobes and 60% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels in the medial and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white fields located on the lateral-distal regions of both lobes. The left lobe white field is larger and more solid, extending from the tip to approximately mid-lobe. The right lobe white field is segmented by a higher density of low-intensity dark pixel mottling. Central medial region near the notch is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 80 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 15% into the fluke chord length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Frequency increases toward the distal tips, with higher amplitude 'peaks' (3-5 pixels) visible on the outer edge of the left lobe compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trajectory on the trailing edge leading to tapered, upward-pointing distal tips. The leading edge (submerged) follows a concave arc toward the peduncle.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several dark, circular pixel clusters (approx. 5-10 pixels in diameter) distributed within the white field of the distal left lobe. A cluster of smaller dark spots is visible near the upper-mid region of the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged edge topography on the far distal tip of the left lobe, indicating minor historical tissue loss or characteristic wear.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific isolated dark-pixel 'island' (approx. 15x10 pixel area) located within the white pigmentation field on the distal-most portion of the left lobe.
